description: FERC eLibrary documents, one row per document: Issuances (orders, notices BY FERC) and Submittals (filings TO FERC). Dockets: e.g. 'ER26-1234' (electric), 'P-5737' (hydro). category, class_type and text filter within a 5,000-row window. since/until: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the sort_by date. Default: posted_date desc, 50 rows. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_ferc_filings

library.description: Electric (E), Gas (G), Oil (O), Hydro (H), Rulemaking (RM), General (Gen). Ignored with docket_number.
